This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Andor" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by their [[Color|blue]] skin, semi-furry bodies, and large mandibles.<ref name="Andor" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date 5BBY">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' dates the events of "Announcement" to [[5 BBY]].</ref> a member of this species could be found on the [[planet]] [[Niamos]], specifically lounging on the beaches around [[Pier Nine]] when [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] was arrested.<ref name="Andor" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Oki-Poki-Unidentified-Mandible-Species.png|thumb|right|250px|This species' mask seen behind oki-poki on the set of Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]
This species was first designed for the [[2019]] film, ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]], though it ultimately did not make the final cut,<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> the mask only shown in the behind-the-scenes bonus footage included with the Blu-ray release of the film,<ref name="Cut">{{HomeVideoCite|film=9|featurette=Cast of Creatures}}</ref> though it was worn by [[Tom Wilton]] during at least one deleted scene taking place on [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Tom Wilton">{{Twitter|tomKwilton|status/1241287872369524736|[[Tom Wilton]]|date=2020-03-21|quote=Can’t help with the first 3 (although the 1st guy looks like a Kimiji character to me) but the last pic is a pull on head that I got fitted for in Jordan as a background character to populate the scene where Rey travels to Tatooine. They went in a different direction in the end|archivefile=File:TomWiltonNickKellington-TROSExtras-Twitter.png}} {{C|In response to: Need some help! Trying to figure out where these characters are supposed to be (which planet/scene) in #StarWars #TheRiseOfSkywalker. Maybe @missingwords can tell, or @tomKwilton @NickKellington have seen them on set? The last one I've not seen outside creature shop.}}</ref> The species would later make it's full official debut when the costume was recycled for seventh episode of the 2022 television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor|Andor]]''.<ref name="Andor" />
